definitions.explanation: The twelfth and last sign of the Western zodiac, covering people born roughly February 19 to March 20. Also the constellation Pisces. Used in horoscopes and casual talk about star signs.

examples.japanese: {私|わたし}は{魚座|うおざ}です。
{魚座|うおざ}の{人|ひと}はやさしいと{言|い}われる。
examples.english: Pisces people are said to be kind.

examples.japanese: {今週|こんしゅう}の{魚座|うおざ}は、{直感|ちょっかん}を{信|しん}じて{動|うご}くといいそうだ。
examples.english: This week's horoscope says Pisces should trust their intuition and act on it.

notes:
The zodiac sign Pisces, for people born from mid-February to late March. Read うおざ, not さかなざ.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {魚座|うおざ}の{人|ひと}: a person born under Pisces
- {魚座|うおざ}{生|う}まれ: born a Pisces
- {魚座|うおざ}の{運勢|うんせい}: the Pisces horoscope

USAGE:
Star signs are common small-talk in Japan and appear in magazine and morning-TV horoscope segments ({星占|ほしうらな}い).
